descs: Walled pasture climbs the fellside, drystone on every side and slate underfoot where the turf gives out.

spots.name: Windward Crag
spots.desc: Bare crag closes off the fell's top edge here, wind scouring even the lichen thin. Nothing grows above this line; nothing has ever needed to.
spots.brief: Bare crag; the fell's top edge.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 4 south and 1 east, then down. The bound-stone: 6 south.

spots.name: The High Scree
spots.desc: Loose scree fans down off the crag-line, every step a small negotiation with the slope. Above it, rock; below it, the walled pasture starts again.
spots.brief: Loose scree; rock above, pasture below.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 4 south, then down. The bound-stone: 5 south and 1 west, then south.

spots.name: Crag Hollow
spots.desc: A hollow scooped into the crag-foot holds last winter's snow long after the rest of the fell has forgotten it. The rock overhead keeps its own weather.
spots.brief: A crag-foot hollow, holding old snow.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 4 south and 1 west, then down. The bound-stone: 5 south and 2 west, then south.

spots.name: The West Fold
spots.desc: A drystone fold pens the last of this year's lambs, walls chest-high and older than anyone who has ever leaned on them. Fresh droppings say it's still worked.
spots.brief: A drystone lambing-fold, still worked.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 3 south and 3 east, then down. The bound-stone: 2 east and 5 south.

spots.name: Sheep-Creep Wall
spots.desc: A low gap is built into the drystone here on purpose, just wide enough for a sheep and nothing bigger, worn smooth at the edges by four hundred years of wool.
spots.brief: A sheep-creep, built into the wall on purpose.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 3 south and 2 east, then down. The bound-stone: 4 south and 1 east, then south.

spots.name: The Slate-Scar
spots.desc: A pale scar cuts into the fellside where slate's been worked out of it for as long as Slatefold's had a name, split flags stacked in neat, waiting rows nobody's carted off yet.
spots.brief: A quarried slate-scar; split flags stacked.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 3 south and 1 east, then down. The bound-stone: 5 south.

spots.name: The Waymark Cairn
spots.desc: A cairn stands taller than a man, stones added by hands going back further than anyone's kept count, marking a way that isn't a road so much as a habit worn into rock.
spots.brief: A tall waymark cairn, built up over centuries.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 3 south, then down. The bound-stone: 4 south and 1 west, then south.

spots.name: The Tarn
spots.desc: A black, still tarn fills a fold in the rock, deep enough that the bottom's a rumor rather than a fact. Nothing breaks its surface, not even wind.
spots.brief: A black, still tarn; unbroken surface.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 3 south and 1 west, then down. The bound-stone: 4 south and 2 west, then south.

spots.name: The Stony Rigg
spots.desc: A stony ridge runs the pasture's edge here, too broken for grazing, good for nothing but a clear look at weather coming in off the Spine.
spots.brief: A stony ridge; weather visible off the Spine.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 west and 3 south, then down. The bound-stone: 3 west and 5 south.

spots.name: Fell's Elbow
spots.desc: The pasture bends hard here around a shoulder of bare rock, the wall following the turn a little too closely for a cart to ever have used this way.
spots.brief: A hard bend around bare rock.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 south and 3 east, then down. The bound-stone: 2 east and 4 south.

spots.name: The Cragfoot Crack
spots.desc: A crack splits the rock at the crag's foot, just wide enough to turn sideways into. Old wax drips mark the entrance, long since gone hard and gray.
spots.brief: A crack in the crag's foot; old wax at the mouth.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 south and 2 east, then down. The bound-stone: 3 south and 1 east, then south.

spots.name: The Long Wall
spots.desc: A single drystone wall runs the whole width of this ground, unbroken by gate or gap, built by someone who meant it to last exactly as long as it has.
spots.brief: An unbroken drystone wall, the pasture's length.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 south and 1 east, then down. The bound-stone: 4 south.

spots.name: Windrow Pasture
spots.desc: Walled pasture, ordinary and close-cropped, wind combing the grass the same direction it combs it every day of the year.
spots.brief: Ordinary walled pasture, wind-combed flat.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 south, then down. The bound-stone: 3 south and 1 west, then south.

spots.name: The Beck Ford
spots.desc: The beck that runs off the fell crosses shallow and clear here, stones underfoot worn flat by four hundred years of the same careful crossing.
spots.brief: The beck's ford; flat stones underfoot.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 south and 1 west, then down. The bound-stone: 3 south and 2 west, then south.

spots.name: The Goat Stair
spots.desc: Rock steps down in a rough stair here, too even to be wholly natural, worn to a shine in the middle by hooves and boots both.
spots.brief: A rough natural stair, worn to a shine.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 west and 2 south, then down. The bound-stone: 3 west and 4 south.

spots.name: The Low Pasture
spots.desc: Walled pasture, lower and greener than the ground above it, sheltered enough that the grass here never quite goes to frost-brown.
spots.brief: Low, sheltered walled pasture.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 south and 3 east, then down. The bound-stone: 2 east and 3 south.

spots.name: The Shepherd's Stone
spots.desc: A single standing stone leans at the pasture's center, waist-high, its face worn smooth where generations of shepherds have rested a hand on it counting sheep.
spots.brief: A standing stone, worn smooth by counting hands.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 south and 2 east, then down. The bound-stone: 2 south and 1 east, then south.

spots.name: Fold Gap
spots.desc: A gap stands open in an old fold-wall here, hinge-pins rusted solid in a gate that hasn't swung shut in longer than the rust has taken to set.
spots.brief: A fold-gap; a gate rusted open.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 south and 1 east, then down. The bound-stone: 3 south.

spots.name: The Lime-Pit
spots.desc: A burned-out lime-pit sits cold in the turf, stone loaded and half-fired, abandoned mid-burn by hands that never came back to finish it.
spots.brief: A cold lime-pit, half-fired and abandoned.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 south, then down. The bound-stone: 2 south and 1 west, then south.

spots.name: Tower Rise
spots.desc: The ground rises hard toward a broken tower's foot, steps just visible spiralling up into weathered stone. Nothing about the climb looks like it was ever meant to be easy.
spots.brief: Rising ground; a broken tower's foot, up.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 south and 1 west, then down. The bound-stone: 2 south and 2 west, then south.

spots.name: West Ridge
spots.desc: A low ridge runs the pasture's western edge, walled pasture on one side and bare rock falling away on the other, wind never quite settling on either.
spots.brief: A low ridge; pasture one side, bare rock the other.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 3 east, then down. The bound-stone: 2 east and 2 south.

spots.name: The Fold Corner
spots.desc: The last of the walled pasture gives out at a low hut tucked against the rock, smoke curling thin from its chimney regardless of the hour, a well-kept skep-hive standing sentry by the door.
spots.brief: The pasture's corner; a low hut, smoke curling.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 east, then down. The bound-stone: 1 south and 1 east, then south.

spots.name: Chapel Bank
spots.desc: The ground rises toward a low chapel roof, door standing ajar the way it's stood for longer than any lock would have lasted. Small handprints show, faint, in the old plaster by the door.
spots.brief: Rising ground; a chapel door standing ajar.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 east, then down. The bound-stone: 2 south.

spots.name: The Hour-Paddock
spots.desc: A small paddock, walled higher than any sheep-fold needs to be, gate hung with a latch set at a child's own reach. The wards were let out here one hour a day, and nowhere else, ever.
spots.brief: A high-walled paddock; a child-height latch.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 west, then down. The bound-stone: 1 south and 2 west, then south.

spots.name: Wood's Edge
spots.desc: The last walled pasture gives out here where holly begins to show among the grass, the Kingswood's own bound creeping up the fell a little further with every passing year.
spots.brief: The wood's holly creeping up the fell's edge.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 north and 2 east, then down. The bound-stone: 1 east, then south.

spots.name: The Fell Road
spots.desc: The old fell road itself runs through here, rutted deep enough by cart-wheels to have carried thirty-one children up it once, and not one of them back down.
spots.brief: The old fell road; deep-rutted cart-wheel tracks.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 north, then down. The bound-stone: 1 west, then south.

actions.label: read the road for where it walks (wits)
fx: Small, slow prints keep to the road's near rut, never the far one, and never past the paddock's old gate. Whatever walks this road at night keeps to a line as fixed as any lesson learned by rote.
The ruts look the same from every angle you try them. It can be read again.

actions.label: read the road's line at a glance
fx: A worn line reads the same to you as any spoor: the near rut, never the far one, never past the paddock gate. You have the slow walker's whole round before you've broken a sweat.

actions.label: cut the bound by the line (might, 1hp)
fx: You keep to the far rut the whole way, driving stakes at every turn the map calls for. Something small and slow stands at the road's near edge the whole time and never once steps toward you.
A stake glances off buried rock and near takes your thumb with it. The bound holds its line anyway, barely. It can be tried again.

actions.label: cut the bound blind (might, 2hp fail)
fx: You guess a line through the dark and drive stakes on faith alone. Something small and slow watches from the paddock gate the whole time, and lets you finish.
You drive a stake wrong without knowing the line, and something small and slow is suddenly very close. You finish the bound anyway, shaking. It can be tried again.

spots.name: Wether Close
spots.desc: A walled close for the wethers, gate latched fast, wool caught in tufts on every stone the flock has ever leaned against.
spots.brief: A walled close for wethers; wool on every stone.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 north and 1 west, then down. The bound-stone: 2 west, then south.

spots.name: The Green Path
spots.desc: The pasture opens here toward a path worn down-slope, hearth-smoke visible over the last wall. This is as close as the wild fell comes to the village that tends it.
spots.brief: A worn path down-slope; Slatefold's smoke below.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: Slatefold's roofs are right there, down. The bound-stone: 1 south and 1 west, then south.

spots.name: The Bound Slope
spots.desc: The walled pasture gives out here at a weathered bound-stone, the Kingswood's holly just visible beyond it where the wood's own bound begins.
spots.brief: A bound-stone; the wood's holly beyond it.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 1 north and 1 east, then down. The bound-stone is right there, south.

spots.name: Under the Switchback
spots.desc: The last walled pasture gives out here where the ground opens east toward black ice and a goat-track's stony descent, Coldpass' own bound close at hand.
spots.brief: Pasture gives out; black ice and a goat-track east.

actions.label: get your bearings
fx: As the fell runs, Slatefold is 2 west and 1 south, then down. The bound-stone: 3 west and 3 south.

onEnter: Something small comes over the rise behind you, unhurried, a slate held tight under one arm — walking, as it always does, for a road home it never quite reaches.

vars.NAME: the Sending Beacon
vars.VIEW: Slatefold's roofs lie below, the Fostering's dark roofline north of the green, the Kingswood a shadow south
vars.SIGN: The beacon-cage stands full-laid, unlit — no house was ever judged loyal enough to light it for.
vars.LOOT: a signal-horn, its mouth gone green with age

vars.NAME: the Letter Hollow
vars.SIGN: Old wax seals line a ledge just inside — a wards' hiding place once, for letters home the porch stopped taking.
vars.LOOT: a bundle of undelivered letters, their ink long since run to nothing

vars.NAME: the Confirming Chapel
vars.SIGN: Small handprints, thirty-one of them, press into the old plaster at a child's reaching height.

vars.NAME: the High Fold
vars.SIGN: A tally-stick hangs by the door, notched in thirty-one places nobody but Cade seems to bother counting.
vars.LOOT: a well-carved crook, worn smooth at the grip
vars.VOICE: Cade counts the flock twice, always the same names.

ff_tall_child.name: a tall child
ff_tall_child.desc: A ward's shade grown old inside a child's smock, small careful steps far too slow for the years worn into its face, a slate clutched tight under one arm.
onDeath: It comes apart into old wool and chalk-dust before it finishes falling, the slate shattering last of all. Somewhere north, for a moment, the Fostering's bell-rope stops swaying.
